mapper.select: SELECT post_id AS postId, title, content, writer, view_count AS viewCount, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM question ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT post_id AS postId, title, content, writer, view_count AS viewCount, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM question WHERE post_id = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question (title, content, writer, view_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{writer}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE question SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId}
